ingredients.raw: 2 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil, divided
ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp. kosher salt, divided, plus more to taste
ingredients.name: kosher salt

ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp. ground black pepper, plus more to taste
ingredients.name: ground black pepper

instructions.text: Set the oven to broil on high. Arrange the oven racks so the top one is close to the heating element. Line a baking sheet with foil and arrange the bread on it. Broil the bread for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Brush one side of the toasted bread with 1 tablespoon of oil and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt.

Cut the avocados in half, pit them, and scoop the flesh into a medium bowl, discarding the skin. Add the lemon juice, remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, and pepper. Stir with a fork, gently mashing the avocado.
Divide the mashed avocado among the toasted bread. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes, if desired.
